system.description: This trait is only available to biomorphs. This morph suffers from space sickness and does not fare well in zero gravity. Apply a -10 impairment modifier in any microgravity climate. Additionally, the first time you must acclimate or endure excessive movement in microgravity, you must make a SOM Check or spend 1 hour incapacitated by nausea.

effects.description: First time must acclimate or endure excessive movement in micrograv, make a SOM Check or be incapacitated by nausea for 1 hour
